payload.text: Run the daily triage sweep. **Load the `triage-playbook` and `github-labeling` skills.** For each repo in the vault key `team.github_repos`, run the `eng.sweep_open_issues` workflow: list open issues with no `priority/P*` label, classify each against the P0–P3 rubric, label it, and post + file its assessment. Batch any genuinely-ambiguous issues (missing repro AND unclear impact) into the digest rather than guessing. When done, file the sweep as a board record: create_task({ kind: 'routine', assigned_to: 'triage-agent', title: 'Triage sweep — <date>', context: <the digest: N triaged per repo, the P0/P1 list, and the ambiguous-issues list>, priority: 'later' }) with NO notify_channel, then complete_task it with the same summary so it lands on the board without paging the user. If a P0 was found, make it explicit in the digest. Write the wake digest to memory/YYYY-MM-DD.md. If nothing was untriaged and nothing moved, reply with the single literal token NO_REPLY.

Produce the weekly issue-health report. **Load the `triage-playbook` skill.** For each repo in `team.github_repos`, run the `eng.weekly_report` workflow: gather open vs closed this week, the current P0–P3 criticality mix, issues stale >30d, still-unlabeled count, and the oldest untriaged issue; write the report to wiki/Knowledge/GitHub-Triage/<repo>/weekly-<date>.md. Then file it on the board: create_task({ kind: 'digest', assigned_to: 'triage-agent', title: 'Weekly issue health — <date>', context: <the report summary across repos>, priority: 'later' }) with NO notify_channel, and complete_task it with the headline numbers. Write the wake digest to memory/YYYY-MM-DD.md. If there were no watched repos configured, reply with the single literal token NO_REPLY.
